Name: More Romantic Harvey Marriage Dialogue - CP
Author: shinymofo
Description:
[center][size=1]I'm still learning to code, and I thought Stardew Valley would be an easy enough task! 
[/size][size=5]
[b]What it do?[/b][/size][b]
[/b]
This mod adds 32 lines of dialogue to Harvey IN MARRIAGE for some more romantical fantastical moments. Maybe a few funnies as well :>

[b][size=5]Do it work?[/size]
[/b]
Should do, I think.
It's compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2542]Harvey Marriage Expansion[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8403]Big Harvey Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2385?tab=description]Doki Doki Dialogue - Harvey[/url], as far as I am aware

[size=5]How to install[/size]
[url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download the Content Patcher Mod[/url]
[size=2]Download my mod and [/size][b][size=2]unzip[/size][/b][size=2] it into the [/size][b][size=2]Stardew Valley/Mods[/size][/b][size=2] folder[/size]
[size=2]Open the game using [b]SMAPI.﻿[/b][/size]
﻿[/center]
